title: ATV Training Session
includes: There will be up to a 1 hour check-in period followed by up to 1 hour of training and riding
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
All guests must speak and understand English
All minors must be accompanied by a parent
A signed waiver will be required in order to participate
No skirts or dresses, no open toed shoes
Must be 16+ with a valid ID to participate
Must be at least 18+ with a valid ID and credit or debit card to book
For the best experience we recommend booking the early morning tour times, temps are cooler and group sizes are smaller
This option is for single-passenger ATVs for ages 16+.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is a great option for beginners wanting to go ATVing! You will receive personalized and hands-on training. Your ATV Training includes a safety operations briefing and some riding on our awesome test course, known as "The Sidewinder." The Sidewinder is full of turns, bumps, and hills that will help you go from beginner to expert! You’ll be accompanied by a certified guide with a vast knowledge of off-roading, Sonoran Desert wildlife, history, and survival techniques. This is a 1-hour ATV training session but you may be with us for up to 2-hours total. This time includes up to 1-hour of checking in and gearing up followed by up to 1-hour of training & riding.

This option is for single-passenger ATVs for ages 16+. To book multi-passenger vehicles, search for our "Centipede Tour - Guided Arizona Desert Tour by UTV."
